subject: Spec review 1 of 3: FAIL, 13 blocking
body: Ran /sc:spec-panel-ledger (critique, requirements+architecture) as review 1 of 3 on orca-worker-contract-spec.md and wrote review/spec-panel.md with a numbered findings list (17 findings, path:line evidence), a boundary table and one ledger-input block; find --dry-run accepted it (rows 17, blocking 13, deferred 4); the spec and ledger were not modified. Verdict FAIL: the section 1 architecture decision holds, but WC-4's report-file rule breaks for workflow (--output retired), file-valued --output (tdd, init-lite), adversarial's conflicting path, the success/succeeded status vocabulary and troubleshoot's TFEP file at the same path; AC-0.4 cannot pass in P0, 7.2 step 6 fails in a shared worktree, the AC-C5 additive regex misses deleted bullets, and WC-3, WC-6, WC-7, WC-9 (P1 no-op) and WC-10 (subagent waits) each have a concrete wrong outcome. Left for the coordinator ledger step: run find --input review/spec-panel.md and close --report review/spec-panel.md, then the Task 6 reviser addresses the 13 blocking rows.
